indicator_name: Outbound International Remittances (via money transfer systems)
description: Исходящие международные денежные переводы через СМДП
methodology: Million KZT. Total across all international money transfer systems (MoneyGram, Unistream, Contact, Golden Crown, UPT, and others), via IMTS operators only -- does not capture remittances through other channels (e.g. bank wire transfers).
